verdict.rationale: Fedora's own Workstation page states you can 'flip a switch to turn on dark mode' and 'use night light to reduce screen glare,' which covers both halves of the story directly. The evidence is a single first-party marketing sentence with no further depth. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation (e.g., night light scheduling or color-temperature controls, how dark mode applies across apps), independent or hands-on corroboration.
